_watch_help: jumuah_watch: {url, label} or {url, seen}. Each daily run re-reads the page. With label ('<label> at <time>'), a new time replaces the hand entry. With seen (the midday times found next to Jumu'ah words when it was set up), the hand entry stays and any difference opens a GitHub issue. A page that is gone or unreadable also opens an issue.
_masjiddashboard_help: masjiddashboard_id: the companyId from a masjid's MasjidDashboard prayer widget. Its times replace Masjidal's for that masjid.
